fixtures.text: At closing, Iona copied the receipts. Her heart was glass; the pencil left splinters in the margin.
During the evacuation, Iona copied the receipts while alarms sounded. Her heart was glass; the pencil left splinters in the margin.
Iona sorted the ferry stubs. The route map opened like an accordion; each pier folded into the next pleat.
With the last ferry missing, Iona sorted the stubs under the searchlight. The route map opened like an accordion; each pier folded into the next pleat.
Iona filed the late receipts. Her heart was glass; the pencil became a battlefield across the margin.
As the platform cleared after the blast, Iona filed the receipts. Her heart was glass; the pencil became a battlefield across the margin.
Before lunch, Iona revised the harbor list. The route map was a brass lung; each pier opened like a wound.
After the rescue boat returned empty, Iona revised the harbor list. The route map was a brass lung; each pier opened like a wound.
